description: Baseline Electron knowledge base with minimal harness

features.name: Window Launch
features.description: Electron app opens a BrowserWindow with correct dimensions and preload script
features.evidence: npm run dev builds and launches the Electron window at 1200x800 with contextIsolation=true and nodeIntegration=false

features.name: Document List Panel
features.description: Left sidebar shows imported documents with empty state message
features.evidence: DocumentList includes a searchable empty state and selectable document rows with indexed status

features.name: Question Panel
features.description: Bottom input bar accepts questions and submits via IPC
features.evidence: QuestionPanel submits through window.knowledgeBase.qa.ask on Enter or click and renders grounded citations

features.name: Data Directory
features.description: PersistenceService creates and manages userData/knowledge-base-data directory
features.evidence: PersistenceService creates data, documents, and index subdirectories under app.getPath('userData')/knowledge-base-data; verified at C:/Users/x1438/AppData/Roaming/knowledge-base/knowledge-base-data
